## What's new since 1.8.0

The PowerShell edition catches up with the desktop edition's release 1.11 (all of it except the new SQL formatter).

**Grids**
- A Refresh button, and Apply keeps the view you had.
- Load more and Load all at the end of a result.
- An arrow in a foreign key cell goes to the referenced row.
- Text can be selected in read-only results, and a click after scrolling hits the cell under the mouse.
- A row no longer grows while the value panel is open; the 0/1 dropdown text is no longer cut off.

**Filters**
- `*` in column filters, and a fuzzy filter for the object list.
- The quick filter can take a value of your own or the one on the clipboard.

**Tabs and editor**
- Back to the last tab when one closes, one tab per table, wrapping tab rows, and a double click on the tab bar opens a new tab.
- New tabs open at the editor height you last dragged to.
- Autocomplete gives LIKE with `'%%'`.

**Output window**
- Long SQL is no longer cut off: it opens in full on a click.

**Connections and server**
- Manage connections has a sidebar with Duplicate and Delete.
- Server processes: sortable, resizable columns.
- The browser's own right-click menu is off; an entry with a submenu keeps the menu open.

**Fixes of this edition**
- Reading more rows of a large result after a pause of more than a minute no longer fails: the server now waits as long as the app does.
- An answer from the app's own server that is not a result now shows as an error naming the request, instead of the "server unavailable" screen.
- Adding to a long query history no longer reads the whole file each time.

**Known limits of this edition**
- Because it runs queries through `mysql.exe`, a script's "rows changed" count reads 0 when the server's warnings are read with it, `ROW_COUNT()` in the next statement reads -1, and a plain SELECT's own warnings are not shown.
- Format keeps the edition's own formatter.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/monsama/nobs-sql-editor-powershell/compare/v1.8.0...v1.9.0
